_comment: Plugin hooks are PROJECT-SCOPED: the scripts act on the CURRENT project's agentic-sop-kit/ (via $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR) and no-op when the project has not adopted the kit, so installing this plugin globally never fires regression in unrelated projects. Exec form (command + args): no shell, so ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} needs no quoting. Each script checks the Python version first and no-ops with a message below 3.8.
